description: Abstract class implementing ServiceInterface, managing event observers, internal event bus, diagnostics, and critical functions for services.

classes.name: AbstractService
classes.description: Abstract base class for services, providing event handling, diagnostics, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Registers an event observer and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: notifyEvent
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies all observers and publishes an event via internal event bus.

methods.name: notifyEventSync
methods.description: Synchronously notifies all observers and publishes an event with sequence strategy.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Returns diagnostic info, defaulting to undefined.

methods.name: blockDeinit
methods.description: Blocks deinitialization until all critical promises are resolved.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deregisters observers and clears internal references for cleanup.

methods.name: executeCriticalFunction
methods.description: Wraps a promise-returning function, tracking it as critical.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Optional override for handling application stage changes.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the service.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages if logging is enabled.
